name: FridgeGraph - Orbit activation SMS deep link

meta.purpose: On Orbit activation, text the operator's own test contact a deep link that OPENS the alert in the web app.

security.paramsChooseLandingOnly: persona and alert are routing hints. They grant nothing: the app still requires a demo session (/api/demo/login) and forwards the caller's real bearer to the graph. Deleting or editing either parameter changes where you land, not what you may read.
security.noPhoneInRepo: the recipient is a GHL contact id supplied by the operator at run time; no phone number is stored in this file
security.sendsOnlyThroughAuthorizedPath: the GHL call uses the configured credential reference; nothing here dials or texts outside it

nodes.name: Orbit activated
nodes.notes: Body: { alertId, childId, personaId }. Called after orbitActivate succeeds. A retry with the same alertId is harmless: the message just points at the same alert.

nodes.name: Operator contact configured?
nodes.notes: Fail closed and loudly: no contact id means no send, and the run reports why instead of texting a guess.

nodes.name: Send SMS (GHL)
nodes.notes: The credential is bound in the n8n UI; this file never carries a token. Inactive until the operator activates the workflow.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { sent: false, reason: 'no operator contact configured (FRIDGEGRAPH_OPERATOR_CONTACT_ID)', alertId: $json.alertId } }];
